description: Daily foreign-exchange rate history as a dataset (ECB reference rates): base currency (default USD), comma-separated symbols (default AUD,EUR,GBP,JPY), date range from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD (max 366 days, default last 30). Returns one row per business day plus a ready-to-save CSV. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402, or 12 sats Cashu ecash (NUT-24), or 12 sats over Lightning (L402).
name: dataset_fx
